problem: shift every key at or after a position in an ordered index (sibling coordinates, measured rows)
chosen: lazy propagation on AVL keys (pending shift per node, parent links)

problem: remove a key range from a balanced tree
chosen: split, split, join2 (join-based AVL, Blelloch et al. 2016)
alternative: one removal per key, O(r log n)

problem: offset of a row with sparse measured extents under row inserts/removes
chosen: order-statistic tree with subtree count and sum: (row - rank) x estimate + prefix
alternative: sorted array + Fenwick tree (rebuild on a middle insert)

problem: state lane of a scrolling window
alternative: copy into a spare lane per move

problem: pending changes of a hidden window
chosen: one dirty span folded in O(1) per run; one show patch
alternative: exact range set (M3RangeSet), O(ranges) per shifted run
